parts.name: Cabinet Frame
parts.Basic_description: The cabinet frame is the main structural body of the cabinet, made of plywood. It provides the overall shape and support for other components.
parts.Functional_description: It supports the door, drawer, and base, maintaining the cabinet’s rigidity and stability.
parts.Movement_description: It is a fixed, non-moving part that holds other components in place.

parts.name: Cabinet Base
parts.Basic_description: The cabinet base is the bottom platform of the cabinet, made of plywood, providing foundational support.
parts.Functional_description: It supports the weight of the cabinet and ensures stability on the floor.
parts.Movement_description: It is a stationary part that does not move during normal use.

parts.name: Cabinet Door
parts.Basic_description: The cabinet door is a solid wood panel attached to the frame with hinges, allowing access to the storage space inside.
parts.Functional_description: It opens and closes to provide access to the cabinet’s interior while protecting contents from dust and damage.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates about its hinges to open and close.

parts.name: Drawer
parts.Basic_description: The drawer is a sliding storage component made of plywood, located above the cabinet door.
parts.Functional_description: It provides a compartment for storing smaller items and can be pulled out for access.
parts.Movement_description: It slides in and out along rails or runners.
